title: GGDriver: Glance at What Is Shared, Gaze at What Differs for Perception-Free Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A planner deciding whether to turn left or continue straight needs to inspect different parts of the scene for each maneuver. Yet many end-to-end driving planners evaluate every candidate trajectory against the same compressed scene representation. We let each candidate select the visual evidence used to refine and score it. A global glance first produces trajectory hypotheses from shared scene features. We then project a corridor around each trajectory into the camera views and use the resulting mask to attend to patch features at the backbone's native resolution. After refinement, the scorer projects each final proposal again and ranks it using evidence along its own path. This geometric selection requires only the predicted trajectory and camera calibration. translated_title: GGDriver：一览共享信息，注视差异之处，实现无感知规划
translated_abstract: 一个需要决定是左转还是继续直行的规划器，需要针对每个驾驶动作检查场景的不同部分。然而，许多端到端驾驶规划器使用相同的压缩场景表示来评估所有候选轨迹。我们让每个候选轨迹自行选择用于细化和评分的视觉证据。首先通过全局“一瞥”从共享场景特征生成轨迹假设。然后，我们将每条轨迹周围的走廊投影到相机视图中，并使用生成的掩码在骨干网络的原生分辨率上关注图像块特征。细化完成后，评分器再次投影每个最终方案，并利用沿其自身路径的证据对其进行排序。这种几何选择只需要预测轨迹和相机标定信息。在三种采用不同场景表示的规划器上（学习式寄存器、感知监督的鸟瞰图网格以及粗粒度图像标记网格），加入这种“注视”机制均能带来提升……
tldr: 该论文提出GGDriver方法，通过让每个候选轨迹根据自身路径动态选择并关注相关的视觉证据进行细化与评分，从而提升端到端自动驾驶规划的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GGDriver, which lets each candidate trajectory dynamically select and attend to relevant visual evidence along its own path for refinement and scoring, improving end-to-end autonomous driving planning performance.
